Cargar bibliotecas
```{r}
library(nycflights13)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(DT)
```

```{r}
data("flights")
data("airlines")
data("airports")
data("planes")
data("weather")
```

```{r}
flights %>% 
  slice_head(n = 100) %>% 
  datatable(options = list(pageLength = 10))
```

```{r}
data.frame(
  datos = c("flights", "airlines", "airports", "planes", "weather"),
  filas = c(nrow(flights), nrow(airlines), nrow(airports), nrow(planes), nrow(weather)),
  columnas = c(ncol(flights), ncol(airlines), ncol(airports), ncol(planes), ncol(weather)),
  tipo_general = c(class(flights), class(airlines), class(airports), class(planes), class(weather))
)

```


```{r}
sum(is.na(flights$dep_time))
mean(is.na(flights$dep_time)) * 100

sum(is.na(flights$dep_delay))
mean(is.na(flights$dep_delay)) * 100

sum(is.na(flights$arr_time))
mean(is.na(flights$arr_time)) * 100

sum(is.na(flights$arr_delay))
mean(is.na(flights$arr_delay)) * 100

sum(is.na(flights$tailnum))
mean(is.na(flights$tailnum)) * 100
```
```{r}
flights_sin_na <- na.omit(flights)

```
